what: the boji arm's v1 result, copied out of .playground/hono-boji before the v2 arm ran over it
why: v2 is maintenance, so every write it makes needs a before, and the playground repository holds v1 only as uncommitted working tree on branch v1
method: sha256 of each tracked file's own sha256, path-sorted, concatenated and hashed again
command: find . -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum
v2_checker_floor: 4 of 20 on this tree, items 1 to 4
note: the playground tree is not committed on branch v1 and an agent may not run a mutating git command, so this copy is the only preserved v1 result besides .playground/hono-boji-run0, which is an earlier and shorter run
